title: Efficient Linear Attention for Multivariate Time Series Modeling via Entropy Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2511.03190v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attention mechanisms are effective for multivariate time series modeling because they adaptively aggregate information across timestamps and variables. Their quadratic cost, however, limits their use in multivariate and spatio-temporal systems. Linear attention reduces this cost by replacing nonlinear attention mappings with forms that support associative computation. Replacing exponential weighting may weaken the amplification of high-score positions and further bias weakly selective distributions toward uniform aggregation. We propose an entropy-calibrated linear attention module and instantiate it as the ELinFormer forecaster. Our operator decomposes aggregation into a uniform component and a query-dependent correction, whose magnitude is calibrated by a query-specific temperature. We derive a second-order KL proxy from centered query-key scores. The Taylor expansion reduces the proxy to the squared-score energy divided by t

translated_title: 基于熵校准的多变量时间序列建模高效线性注意力方法
translated_abstract: 注意力机制在多变量时间序列建模中非常有效，因为它能够自适应地跨时间戳和变量聚合信息。然而，其二次方的计算成本限制了它在多变量和时空系统中的应用。线性注意力通过用支持关联计算的形式替代非线性注意力映射来降低这一成本。但用其他权重替代指数加权可能会削弱对高分位置的放大作用，并进一步使原本弱选择性的分布偏向均匀聚合。我们提出了一种熵校准的线性注意力模块，并将其实现为ELinFormer预测器。我们的算子将聚合过程分解为一个均匀分量和一个依赖查询的修正项，该修正项的幅度由查询特定的温度参数进行校准。我们从中心化的查询-键得分中推导出一个二阶KL散度代理，通过泰勒展开将该代理简化为平方得分能量除以温度的形式……
tldr: 提出了一种熵校准的线性注意力模块ELinFormer，通过将聚合分解为均匀分量与查询依赖的修正项并利用查询特定温度校准，在降低二次计算成本的同时保持对高分位置的选择性放大能力，实现高效的多变量时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes ELinFormer, an entropy-calibrated linear attention module that decomposes aggregation into a uniform component and a query-dependent correction calibrated by query-specific temperature, preserving selective amplification of high-score positions while reducing quadratic attention cost for efficient multivariate time series forecasting.
